messages:
alex: Heads up — when I ran the curl example in /runtime/getting-started it returns a 403. Repro steps: `curl -v https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/getting-started -H 'Accept: application/json'` and the snippet points to a shortlink that 403s. Anyone owning that guide?

maya: I can take a look. Do you have the exact example line that 403s?

alex: It's the presigned-image URL in the second code block under 'Quickstart'. The block shows `curl https://short.redwood/runbook/splash.png` which 403s for me. Wondering if we should rehost or swap to the CDN path.

jamie: Paging @maya — that shortlink has been flaky. We recently rotated the bucket IAM and a few presigned shortlinks expired.

maya: ok. plan: 1) replace shortlink with the canonical CDN path 2) add note in the snippet about auth if someone copies it 3) open a tiny PR with sed to update the markdown. I'll do the PR and ping for CR.

sasha: quick tip — instead of a full rehost, you can replace the inline link with an internal asset path: `/assets/docs/runtime/splash.png`. CDN mapping will serve it and avoids presigned expiry.

maya: perfect, thanks @sasha. I'll do that. Drafting PR now.

docs-bot: PR created — https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4281 — title: "docs(runtime): swap presigned shortlink -> assets path + note" — assignee: maya.

alex: Thanks. Could someone from runtime take a quick CR? @jamie maybe? Low-risk change but want to avoid regressions in the snippet rendering.

jamie: I'll review in ~30m. If CI passes I'll merge. :thumbsup:

maya: PR ready for review and includes the sed one-liner in the PR description for a follow-up sweep: 
```
# replace shortlink with assets path
rg "short.redwood/runbook" -l | xargs sed -i "s|https://short.redwood/runbook|/assets/docs/runtime|g"
```

alex: Nice — that sed looks safe. Leaving a small test note in the PR: preview the page in staging to confirm image renders and the codeblock still copies cleanly.

docs-bot: PR merged by jamie — https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4281 — deployed to staging.

maya: done, verified staging preview shows the image and code snippet copy works. Closing. Thanks everyone! :party_popper:
